headlines.title: Trump says he could pull Blanche's attorney general nomination until GOP holdouts leave
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to pull acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve permanently in the role until two Senate Republicans who are withholding their support leave office next year. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports from Capitol Hill on why the senators oppose advancing Blanche's nomination to the full Senate.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong ‘undecided’ on seeking endorsement from Mandela Barnes after he suspends campaign
headlines.description: Gubernatorial candidate state Rep. Francesca Hong (D-Wis.) joins Meet the Press NOW after former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes suspends his campaign. Hong also discusses her path forward to the Democratic nomination.

headlines.title: Battling wildfires across Europe
headlines.description: Fires continue to rage across Europe, including in France’s wine country. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez was with firefighters and volunteers in the region as they battled the flames.

headlines.title: Father of Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
headlines.description: The man who gifted his 14-year-old son an assault rifle that he then used to unleash a mass shooting at Apalachee High School in Georgia was sentenced to 15 years in prison. A jury convicted Colin Gray on multiple charges, including second-degree murder and involuntary manslaughter. His son was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. NBC News' George Solis reports.

headlines.title: ‘Children of Blood and Bone’ author Tomi Adeyemi says she left set of film adaptation in tears
headlines.description: Author Tomi Adeyemi, whose novel “Children of Blood and Bone” is being made into a movie, said in a TikTok video that she left the set of the book’s film adaptation in tears.

headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Democrats’ novel red-state strategy: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur explores how Democrats are trying to increase their odds of defeating Senate Republicans in deep-red states.

headlines.title: Nursing mother of two and asylum-seeker detained by ICE in Tennessee
headlines.description: The woman, who advocates said fled “extreme domestic violence” in Guatemala, has a 10-month-old baby and a 2-year-old with Down syndrome.

headlines.title: Teen girl kidnapped in Chicago is found alive in Virginia after being held captive for 4 years
headlines.description: A shocking update has ended the mystery of a missing child and kidnapping case, as a teenager who disappeared from Chicago has been found four years later in Virginia, having been held captive all this time, according to NBC 5 Investigates.

headlines.title: Democrat Mandela Barnes drops out of Wisconsin governor’s race
headlines.description: Barnes, the former lieutenant governor and 2022 Senate nominee, departs amid democratic socialist Francesca Hong’s rise in the polls ahead of the Aug. 11 primary.
